description: §13.9.1 S475 rule 1 + §13.9.2: a `let` pending cell whose initializer reads cells re-runs on a dependency change, and it "reads cells" through a called function too. `cur()` reads `@userId`, so `@userId` is the load's dependency: the mount load settles "a", and writing `@userId = 2` re-runs it to "b". RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §13.9.1 "The spelling decides the load (S475, PERMANENT)": "The rule reads the initializer exactly as §66.9 rules 3–4 read any initializer: it "reads cells" when it reads a cell directly or through a called function (§13.9.2's deps)." Rule 1: "`let` + an initializer that reads cells re-runs on a dependency change." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S475 "⭐ RULED — S475 owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 1.
